rules: Avoid Inter/Roboto. Use IBM Plex Sans for all UI text for an authoritative, intelligence-platform feel.
Use IBM Plex Mono for ALL numerical data, risk scores, currency, financial analysis, and unique IDs.
Headings must use tight tracking (tracking-tight) and balanced line heights.
Keep text sizes moderate. Max heading size text-3xl for page titles to maintain an enterprise software density.

layouts.app_shell: flex h-screen bg-[#090A0B] text-[#EDEDED] overflow-hidden selection:bg-[#4D8CFF] selection:text-white
layouts.sidebar: w-[260px] flex-shrink-0 border-r border-[#272A30] bg-[#090A0B] flex flex-col z-20
layouts.header: h-16 border-b border-[#272A30] bg-[#090A0B] flex items-center px-6 justify-between shrink-0 z-10
layouts.main_content: flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 md:p-8 bg-[#090A0B] relative
layouts.transparency_rule: NEVER use transparent backgrounds for headers, sticky panels, or modals. Always use solid #090A0B or #121417.

component name.kpi_card: bg-[#121417] border border-[#272A30] rounded-lg p-5 flex flex-col gap-2 hover:border-[#383C45] transition-colors relative overflow-hidden
component name.data_table: w-full text-sm text-left whitespace-nowrap. Header row bg-[#0D0F12] border-y border-[#272A30] text-[#A0A5B0] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-xs px-4 py-3. Body rows border-b border-[#1E2126] hover:bg-[#1A1D21] transition-colors
component name.risk_badge: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono font-medium border (use risk_semantic colors for bg/text/border)
component name.radial_meter: Use Recharts PieChart with 2 cells (value, remainder). Value color maps to risk tier. Inner radius 80%, outer radius 100%. Center custom label showing score using IBM Plex Mono.
component name.timeline: Left border border-l-2 border-[#272A30] ml-3 relative. Nodes are absolute positioned circles -left-[9px] w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-[#121417] border-2 border-[#4D8CFF].
component name.ai_insight_panel: bg-[#121417] border border-[#272A30] border-t-2 border-t-[#8B5CF6] rounded-lg p-5 flex flex-col gap-3 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(139,92,246,0.05)]
component name.button_primary: bg-[#EDEDED] text-[#090A0B] hover:bg-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded transition-colors text-sm
component name.button_secondary: bg-[#121417] text-[#EDEDED] border border-[#272A30] hover:bg-[#1A1D21] font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded transition-colors text-sm

visual enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Avoid large blurs. Dropdown/Modal shadow: shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)].
visual enhancers.borders: Primary element for structure. 1px solid #272A30. Avoid glassmorphism entirely to maintain linear-quality crispness.
visual enhancers.radius: Moderate and serious. rounded-lg (8px) for panels, rounded-md (6px) for inner components, rounded (4px) for badges and buttons.

motion.page_transition: Framer Motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
motion.rule: No bouncy, exaggerated, or slow animations. Must feel like a high-performance C++ military/intelligence tool, not a consumer social app.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. Primary text #EDEDED against #121417 is 14:1.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='risk-monitor-table', data-testid='kpi-total-expenditure', data-testid='nav-link-dashboard').
accessibility.focus: Focus states must use ring-2 ring-[#4D8CFF] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#090A0B] outline-none.

media.icons: Lucide React. Stroke width 1.5. Icon size 16px or 18px for UI elements, 24px for empty states.
media.charts: Recharts. Grid lines: <CartesianGrid stroke='#272A30' strokeDasharray='3 3' vertical={false} />. Tooltip: contentStyle={{ backgroundColor: '#121417', borderColor: '#272A30', color: '#EDEDED', borderRadius: '8px' }}. Axis: tick={{ fill: '#A0A5B0', fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'IBM Plex Mono' }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false}.

3d libraries.strategy: None needed for this 2D intelligence dashboard. Rely strictly on Recharts and CSS structural styling for an authoritative, data-heavy interface.

image_urls.description: Dark cyber/network abstract background for login or loading states if needed.
Placeholder for user profile or investigating officer.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a production-ready, frontend-only React dashboard using JavaScript (.js/.jsx), NOT TypeScript.
Import Google Fonts for 'IBM Plex Sans' (weights 400, 500, 600) and 'IBM Plex Mono' (weights 400, 500). Apply them in tailwind config.
Implement a persistent App Shell layout with a left sidebar (w-[260px]) and a top header (h-16). Main content should scroll independently.
Build the 4 main views: Command Center, Risk Monitor, Work Investigation, and Programme Analytics.
Populate the UI with extremely realistic mock data representing the MPLAD Scheme (Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme).

Data should include: District names (e.g., Pune, Varanasi), executing agencies, financial figures (in ₹ Lakhs/Crores formatted via IBM Plex Mono), anomaly types (e.g., 'Tender split to avoid oversight', 'Ghost asset detected'), and Risk Scores (0-100).
Never use generic placeholder text like 'Lorem Ipsum'. Always use context-specific mock data.
The AI Sentinel interface should look like an intelligence feed with confidence scores (e.g., 'Confidence: 94%').
Include Recharts for the Programme Analytics, risk trends, and expenditure charts. Make sure chart backgrounds match the dark theme.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Use a dense, bento-grid, enterprise layout.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but rely strictly on 1px borders (#272A30) rather than heavy drop shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Text alignment should be left-aligned for data readability.
Always use modern button styles like sharp rectangular buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use exact spacing as prescribed. Ensure containers with borders have adequate padding (p-5 or p-6).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-button').
Headers MUST have a solid background (bg-[#090A0B]). NEVER use a transparent header over scrolling content.
